name: Notice of Non-Substantive Policy Changes
description: Public notice to the full Board of any non-substantive policy edits made by the Policy Committee (numbering, titles, citations, terminology).
deadline: during the next regular Board meeting or through dissemination of the Policy Committee minutes
quote: The Policy Committee Chair or their designee will publicly notify the Board of any such non-­substantive changes during the next regular Board meeting or through dissemination of the minutes of the Policy Committee to the full Board.
